notes: 19 old kinds collapsed to 6. Aerosol/foam/powder/fogger became types of Insecticide; bait applicator gun became a spare-part type of Insect bait and the ENVU Maxforce gun was dropped as trade equipment. 'Other insect traps' catch-all dissolved into Insect trap with wasp, fruit-fly, clothes-moth, fly-paper and UV glue-board types; Pluslight dropped to reduce Insect-O-Cutor skew. Fly swatter and electric fly killer merged; Genus Liberator and PlusZap dropped as commercial/duplicate grid units. Vaporiser refill SKUs (3) and coil holder dropped as spare-part types; their ranges kept once under Mosquito vaporiser & coil. Bed net and insect screen merged; fitted framed screens belong to Home Fixtures. Brands named in the brief but absent from old data (Raid insecticide, Zero In, Rentokil) were not added because no research was permitted; flag for the department owner. Old 's' URLs retained from the lead kind of each merge.
